notes.title: Hey, it's me again. Patch 1.0.3 has been released!
notes.content:
[h1]Once again, more fixes galore! (I'm tired, boss.)[/h1]
[h2]This time, fixes for the following titles:[/h2]

[h3]The Nest:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed enemy navigation and pathfinding issues.
[/list]

[h3]A Date To Remember:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various collision issue when walking up stairs inside of the main house.
[/list]

notes.title: Annoying Bugs Begone!
notes.content:
[h1]Our first patch is already here, what a joy![/h1]
[h2]This patch includes fixes/additions to the following games:[/h2]

[h3][b]THE NEST:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player may spawn in a random location.
[*] Fixed an issue where the enemy path finding may fail.
[*] Added a scene to prevent the need to backtrack after collecting an item.
[/list]
[h3][b]
A DATE TO REMEMBER:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed collision issues for certain objects.
[*] Fixed the ability to unlock an ending through different, unintended means.
[*] Fixed one of the fuse locations collisions.
[/list]
